entities.name: Query protein P39155
observations: The supplied 150-residue sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P39155 from Bacillus subtilis.
P39155 is annotated as a protein-arginine phosphatase, EC 3.9.1.2, with an LMWPc domain spanning nearly the full sequence.
The enzyme specifically dephosphorylates phosphoarginine residues in proteins and has little activity toward phosphoserine, phosphothreonine, or phosphotyrosine peptides.

entities.name: Protein phosphoarginine hydrolysis
observations: The reaction is mapped to EC 3.9.1.2 and Rhea RHEA:43380 for protein-arginine phosphatase activity.

entities.name: McsB protein arginine kinase
observations: P39155 counteracts the Bacillus subtilis protein arginine kinase McsB by removing protein arginine phosphorylation.
